messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: service=runtime-kv-cache severity=page title=KV cache growth + svc-tail-latency spike >30m.  p50 ok, p99 increased from 180ms -> 2.3s, error-rate 5xx ↑ 1.8% -> 7%. Affected: hosted API region us-west-2. Pager: @alex oncall.

alex: acked. jumping in. seeing a bunch of cache evictions and continuous batch sizes ramping to 64/req. can someone dump HPA/status and recent deploys? :eyes:

ken: I see a config rollout 20m ago from canary: `continuous_batch.max_size` changed  from 16 -> 64 and `kv.prefill=true` in the same patch. rollout id: deploy-20270315-847.

maria: logs show prefix-prefill hot paths causing cache pressure. KV cache keys growing 5x in 10m. autoscaler reacted: HPA spun from 6 -> 18 pods in ~9m, then scale-down oscillation started.

alex: ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback batch size change 2) add HPA stabilization window 3) scale up to steady capacity to absorb warmup. we should also set an emergency rate limit for affected customers.

jess: +1. i'm on customer comms. partial impact: several high-traffic tenants experienced 5xx + timeouts for ~15-40m. no data loss.

opsbot: runbook step triggered by @alex: "rollback suspect config". Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash

ken: executing rollback now — patching configmap and restarting runtime pods with zero-downtime strategy. command:
```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deployment/runtime --from=configmap/kv-runtime-config-previous
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n infra --timeout=120s
```

maria: watching metrics. within 90s we see batch-size distributions return to p50~12, p99 dropping to ~300ms. cache growth rate flattens. HPA still at 16 (in flight).

alex: good. i'll hold the page for stabilization. ken, can you patch the HPA to increase the stabilization window to 5m and add behavior to prefer scale-up throttle? that should avoid sawtooth.

ken: patching HPA:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: runtime-hpa
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 20
          periodSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 60
```
kubectl apply -f runtime-hpa-patch.yaml -n infra
```

maria: also setting a temporary max replicas=25 to prevent unlimited spin while cluster-wide demand settles.

opsbot: NOTE: emergency rate limit applied to top 3 tenants: tenant-42, tenant-77, tenant-12. limit: 30rps per-tenant.

jess: drafting a short customer note: "We detected elevated errors and latency in us-west-2 caused by a batch-config change. We rolled back the change and applied stabilizers; most customers restored within 10-20 minutes. We're following up with a root cause and longer-term mitigations." will post after oncall confirms final state.

alex: observed p99 ~260ms now, error-rate <1.2%. leaving page open for 30m observation. handoff plan: i need to go offline at +25m, will hand to @maria. any followups?

ken: opening an internal postmortem issue with links to deploy, config diff, and metric snapshots. assigning to @ken + @maria for RCA. quick notes: avoid combined `prefill=true` + high `max_size` without cache-limits.

maria: oncall takeover acknowledged. i'll monitor for next 45m and then escalate to platform if trend reappears. followups: add canary checks for cache growth, add throttles in runtime for prefill path, and add a dashboard alarm for continuous-batch median > 20 for >5m.

alex: thanks team. jess please send the customer note now. i'll add the incident severity and ETA for postmortem. :thumbsup:

jess: posted customer note in status.redwood.ai and pinged affected tenants.

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> stabilizing. root cause suspected: misaligned batch sizing + prefill behavior leading to transient key-space amplification and HPA thrash. next steps PR: add safety caps, increase HPA stabilization default, add prefill rate limiter.

maria: adding timeline to the ticket:
- 2176543210 alert triggered
- 2176543340 rollback initiated by ken
- 2176543400 metrics improving
- 2176543600 HPA patched
- 2176543810 handoff to maria (oncall)

alex: handing off. oncall -> @maria. i'm available on DM if anything spikes.

maria: taking over. will run through post-incident checklist and schedule RCA meeting. closing page in 1h if stable. :white_check_mark:
